# package presence

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/presence"
```

Package presence evaluates the presence conditions of IEC 61850 information models (IEC 61850-7-3 Table 1 and the PresenceConditions of the 7-2 NSD, as IEC 61850-7-7 declares them) against an instance: the data objects of a logical node, or the attributes and sub data objects of a data object, that a device or an SCL type actually has.

For every element of the class, a [Result](#type-result) says what the condition requires in this instance (Required, Optional, Forbidden) and whether the instance meets it (Satisfied, Violated):

	ev := presence.New(profile)
	rep, err := ev.LogicalNode("CSWI", &presence.Instance{
		Present: []string{"Beh", "Pos"},
		Children: map[string]*presence.Instance{
			"Pos": {Present: []string{"stVal", "q", "t", "ctlModel"},
				Values: map[string]string{"ctlModel": "sbo-with-enhanced-security"}},
		},
	})
	// rep.Violations() lists Pos.sboTimeout, Pos.stSeld, Pos.operTimeout.

Conditions fall into five families:

  - Unconditional: M, O, F, na, and the multi-instance Mmulti, Omulti, MmultiRange and OmultiRange, which also check instance numbers.
  - Sibling: MF, MO, OF, OM, FM and MmultiF name another element of the same class; the condition holds when that element is present.
  - Group: AtLeastOne, AtMostOne, AllOrNonePerGroup, AllOnlyOneGroup, AllAtLeastOneGroup and MAllOrNonePerGroup relate the elements that share the condition (and group number).
  - Context: MOln0, MFln0, MOrootLD, MOlnNs, MOdataNs, MOcdcNs, MOsbo, MOenhanced, MOrms, MFsubst and the MFscaled\* family depend on where the instance sits (LLN0, the root logical device, the namespaces declared by ldNs, lnNs and dataNs), on attribute values (ctlModel, hvRef) or on other elements of the instance.
  - Fact: MOcond, MFcond, OFcond and the conditions whose subject is not visible in the model (MOoperTm, MONamPlt, MORange, OMSynPh, MFsg, MFnsg) need a fact from the caller ([Context.Facts](#func-context-facts)).

When the instance lacks a fact a condition depends on, the requirement is Undetermined and [Result.Missing](#func-result-missing) names the fact. The evaluator never assumes a default; the verdict is still Satisfied or Violated when every possible value of the fact gives the same outcome (an MO element that is present satisfies its condition either way). [Conditions](#func-conditions) lists every condition with its family and the fact it may need.

The evaluator reads the model through \[Lookup], which \*catalog.Profile implements; \[resolver.Resolver.Presence] is the same evaluation through a resolver. [ValidateNamespace](#func-validatenamespace) checks the presence conditions a namespace declares (known names, well-formed arguments, existing siblings), and [ReadInstance](#func-readinstance) reads the JSON form of an instance that nsdctl model check uses.

IsMultiInstance reports whether the condition allows numbered instances of its data object (Mmulti, Omulti, MmultiRange, OmultiRange, MmultiF).


Known reports whether the evaluator has a rule for the condition.

### func ParseRange

```go
func ParseRange(args string) (lo, hi int, ok bool)
```

ParseRange parses the "min, max" argument of MmultiRange and OmultiRange.

### func ValidateNamespace

```go
func ValidateNamespace(ns *model.Namespace) model.Diagnostics
```

ValidateNamespace checks the presence conditions a namespace uses on its data objects, attributes and members and returns warnings: a condition without an evaluator rule, a missing or malformed argument (group number, "min, max"), an argument on a condition that takes none, and a sibling argument that names no element of the class, CDC or type. Siblings inherited from a class of another namespace cannot be checked here and are not reported.

## Types

### type Condition

```go
type Condition struct {
	// Name is the NSD condition name, e.g. "MOsbo".
	Name string
	// Family is what the condition depends on.
	Family Family
	// Multi marks a multi-instance condition.
	Multi bool
	// Argument describes the argument: "" (none), "n" (group number),
	// "sibling", "condID" or "min, max".
	Argument string
	// Holds says what makes a two-way condition hold, e.g. "ctlModel
	// selects select-before-operate"; empty for the others.
	Holds string
	// IfHolds and Otherwise are the requirements of a two-way condition
	// (MO: Required and Optional); for the others IfHolds is the fixed
	// requirement, or empty for group conditions.
	IfHolds, Otherwise Requirement
	// Needs names the input the condition reads: an attribute value
	// ("ctlModel"), a context field ("lnClass", "rootLD", "ldNs",
	// "lnNs", "dataNs") or "fact" for [Context.Facts]; empty when the
	// model and the present elements suffice.
	Needs string
}
```

Condition describes how the evaluator treats one presence condition.

### type Context

```go
type Context struct {
	// LNClass is the class of the logical node the instance belongs to
	// (MOln0, MFln0: "LLN0" or another class). The logical node
	// evaluation sets it.
	LNClass string `json:"lnClass,omitempty"`
	// RootLD reports whether the logical device is the root logical
	// device (MOrootLD); nil is unknown.
	RootLD *bool `json:"rootLD,omitempty"`
	// LDNamespace is the namespace the logical device declares (LLN0
	// NamPlt.ldNs), e.g. "IEC 61850-7-4:2007B".
	LDNamespace string `json:"ldNs,omitempty"`
	// LNNamespace is the namespace of the logical node: its NamPlt.lnNs,
	// or the namespace that defines its class (MOlnNs, MOdataNs). The
	// logical node evaluation sets it from the class when it is empty.
	LNNamespace string `json:"lnNs,omitempty"`
	// DataNamespace is the namespace of the data object (its dataNs, or
	// the namespace of the class that declares it) for MOdataNs and
	// MOcdcNs. The logical node evaluation sets it per data object.
	DataNamespace string `json:"dataNs,omitempty"`
	// CtlModel is the control model when [Instance.Values] has no
	// ctlModel.
	CtlModel string `json:"ctlModel,omitempty"`
	// Facts state whether a condition holds, keyed by the condition as
	// printed ("MOcond(1)", "MFsubst", "MOoperTm") or by element and
	// condition ("Mir:MOcond(1)"), which wins. A fact overrides what the
	// evaluator would derive.
	Facts map[string]bool `json:"facts,omitempty"`
}
```

Context is what the evaluator knows about the surroundings of an instance. Empty fields are unknown, never defaulted.

#### func (Evaluator) CDC

```go
func (ev *Evaluator) CDC(name string, fc model.FunctionalConstraint, inst *Instance) (*Report, error)
```

CDC evaluates an instance of a data object of the named CDC: its data attributes and sub data objects, and the described children. A CDC with variants (SPG/SP, SPG/SG) takes the variant whose key the instance's Class names, else the one with functional constraint fc, else the first.

#### func (Evaluator) Check

```go
func (ev *Evaluator) Check(inst *Instance) (*Report, error)
```

Check evaluates an instance whose Class names a logical node class, a CDC (or CDC variant key) or a constructed type, tried in that order.

#### func (Evaluator) ConstructedAttribute

```go
func (ev *Evaluator) ConstructedAttribute(name string, inst *Instance) (*Report, error)
```

ConstructedAttribute evaluates an instance of a constructed attribute type: its members and the described children.

#### func (Evaluator) In

```go
func (ev *Evaluator) In(ns model.NamespaceID) *Evaluator
```

In returns an evaluator that looks up logical node classes in namespace ns only (see resolver.Resolver.In).

#### func (Evaluator) LogicalNode

```go
func (ev *Evaluator) LogicalNode(class string, inst *Instance) (*Report, error)
```

LogicalNode evaluates an instance of a logical node class: its data objects, inherited ones included, and the described children against their CDCs. The context gets LNClass, and LNNamespace from the namespace of the class when the instance does not set it; each data object child gets the namespace of its declaring class as DataNamespace.

#### func (Evaluator) Validate

```go
func (ev *Evaluator) Validate(class string, inst *Instance) error
```

Validate evaluates an instance of a logical node class and returns a [\*model.PresenceError](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/model#PresenceError) when a condition is violated. Undetermined conditions do not fail.

### type Family

```go
type Family string
```

Family groups presence conditions by what they depend on.

```go
const (
	// FamilyUnconditional conditions depend on nothing: M, O, F, na and
	// the multi-instance conditions.
	FamilyUnconditional Family = "unconditional"
	// FamilySibling conditions depend on the presence of the element
	// their argument names.
	FamilySibling Family = "sibling"
	// FamilyGroup conditions relate the elements that share the
	// condition and its group number.
	FamilyGroup Family = "group"
	// FamilyContext conditions depend on where the instance sits, on an
	// attribute value or on other elements of the instance.
	FamilyContext Family = "context"
	// FamilyFact conditions depend on a fact the model does not show;
	// they are undetermined unless [Context.Facts] states it.
	FamilyFact Family = "fact"
)
```

Condition families.

### type Instance

```go
type Instance struct {
	// Class optionally names the logical node class, CDC or
	// constructed type of a top-level instance (nsdctl model check
	// reads it); children take theirs from the model.
	Class string `json:"class,omitempty"`
	// Present names the children that exist, by their instance names:
	// data objects with their instance number ("Ind3"), attributes and
	// sub data objects. A dotted entry ("mag.i") records a member of a
	// present constructed attribute.
	Present []string `json:"present"`
	// Values holds attribute values that conditions read, by name:
	// "ctlModel" (CtlModelKind, name or number) for MOsbo and
	// MOenhanced, "hvRef" (HvReferenceKind) for MOrms. An attribute
	// with a value is present.
	Values map[string]string `json:"values,omitempty"`
	// Context carries the facts about the surroundings of the instance.
	// Children inherit it; their own Context fields override.
	Context Context `json:"context,omitzero"`
	// Children describe present children further, by instance name:
	// the attributes of a data object, the members of a constructed
	// attribute. A described child is present; a present child without
	// an entry is checked only for its own presence.
	Children map[string]*Instance `json:"children,omitempty"`
}
```

Instance describes what exists of one logical node, data object or constructed attribute: the input of the evaluation.

#### func ReadInstance

```go
func ReadInstance(r io.Reader) (*Instance, error)
```

ReadInstance reads an instance in its JSON form:

	{"class": "CSWI", "present": ["Beh", "Pos"],
	 "context": {"ldNs": "IEC 61850-7-4:2007B", "facts": {"MOcond(1)": true}},
	 "children": {"Pos": {"present": ["stVal", "q", "t", "ctlModel"],
	                      "values": {"ctlModel": "direct-with-normal-security"}}}}

Unknown fields, trailing data and input beyond MaxInstanceBytes, MaxInstanceNames or MaxDepth levels fail with [model.ErrInvalidInstance](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/model#ErrInvalidInstance) (and [model.ErrLimitExceeded](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/model#ErrLimitExceeded) for the limits).

### type ModelLookup

```go
type ModelLookup interface {
	LogicalNode(name string) (*model.LogicalNodeClass, error)
	DataObjects(lnClass string) ([]catalog.InheritedDataObject, error)
	LogicalNodeIn(ns model.NamespaceID, name string) (*model.LogicalNodeClass, error)
	DataObjectsIn(ns model.NamespaceID, lnClass string) ([]catalog.InheritedDataObject, error)
	CDCVariants(name string) ([]*model.CommonDataClass, error)
	CDCVariantsFrom(from model.NamespaceID, name string) ([]*model.CommonDataClass, error)
	ConstructedAttribute(name string) (*model.ConstructedAttribute, error)
	ConstructedAttributeFrom(from model.NamespaceID, name string) (*model.ConstructedAttribute, error)
}
```

ModelLookup is the set of model lookups the [Evaluator](#type-evaluator) needs. \*catalog.Profile and \*catalog.Catalog implement it, and so does every resolver.Lookup.

### type Report

```go
type Report struct {
	// Path is the path of the instance relative to the top level, empty
	// for the top level.
	Path string `json:"path,omitempty"`
	// Class is the logical node class, CDC (Key form, e.g. "SPG/SG")
	// or constructed type.
	Class string `json:"class"`
	// Results has one entry per element of the class, in model order.
	Results []Result `json:"results"`
	// Unknown lists present names that match no element of the class,
	// e.g. a data object from an extension namespace that the profile
	// does not load.
	Unknown []string `json:"unknown,omitempty"`
	// Children are the reports of the described children
	// ([Instance.Children]), in model order.
	Children []*Report `json:"children,omitempty"`
}
```

Report is the evaluation of one instance.

#### func Evaluate

```go
func Evaluate(class string, elems []Element, inst *Instance) *Report
```

Evaluate evaluates the presence conditions of the elements of one class against an instance and returns one result per element, in the order of elems. Children of the instance are not evaluated: they need the model ([Evaluator](#type-evaluator)). A nil instance is an instance with nothing present.

#### func (Report) All

```go
func (r *Report) All() []Result
```

All returns the results of the report and of every child report.

#### func (Report) Err

```go
func (r *Report) Err() error
```

Err returns a [\*model.PresenceError](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/model#PresenceError) listing the violations, or nil.

#### func (Report) OK

```go
func (r *Report) OK() bool
```

OK reports whether no result is violated. Undetermined results and unknown names do not count.

#### func (Report) Undetermined

```go
func (r *Report) Undetermined() []Result
```

Undetermined returns the results whose verdict is undetermined, children included.

#### func (Report) Violations

```go
func (r *Report) Violations() []Result
```

Violations returns the violated results, children included.

### type Requirement

```go
type Requirement string
```

Requirement is what a presence condition requires of one element in a given instance.

```go
const (
	// Required: the element shall be present.
	Required Requirement = "required"
	// Optional: the element may be present or absent.
	Optional Requirement = "optional"
	// Forbidden: the element shall be absent.
	Forbidden Requirement = "forbidden"
	// Undetermined: the requirement depends on a fact the instance does
	// not provide; [Result.Missing] names it.
	Undetermined Requirement = "undetermined"
)
```

Requirements.

### type Result

```go
type Result struct {
	// Path is the element path relative to the evaluated instance, e.g.
	// "Pos.sboTimeout".
	Path string `json:"path"`
	// Element is the evaluated element.
	Element string `json:"element"`
	// Kind is the element kind.
	Kind Kind `json:"kind"`
	// Condition is the presence condition.
	Condition model.PresenceCondition `json:"condition"`
	// Present reports whether the instance has the element.
	Present bool `json:"present"`
	// Instances are the instance names of a multi-instance element
	// ("Ind1", "Ind2").
	Instances []string `json:"instances,omitempty"`
	// Requirement is what the condition requires in this instance.
	Requirement Requirement `json:"requirement"`
	// Verdict says whether the instance meets it.
	Verdict Verdict `json:"verdict"`
	// Reason explains the requirement and the verdict.
	Reason string `json:"reason"`
	// Missing names the fact an undetermined requirement needs, e.g.
	// "ctlModel" or "fact MOcond(1)".
	Missing string `json:"missing,omitempty"`
}
```

Result is the evaluation of one element.

### type Verdict

```go
type Verdict string
```

Verdict says whether an instance meets the requirement of an element.

```go
const (
	// Satisfied: the instance meets the requirement.
	Satisfied Verdict = "satisfied"
	// Violated: the instance does not meet the requirement.
	Violated Verdict = "violated"
	// Unresolved: the verdict depends on a missing fact; it is shown as
	// "undetermined".
	Unresolved Verdict = "undetermined"
)
```

Verdicts.
